VP8 lossy (baseline/keyframe) decoder, pure Nim. Port of references/image-webp src/vp8.rs (+ vp8_arithmetic_decoder.rs, loop_filter.rs, transform.rs, yuv.rs fancy path) at v0.2.4, which itself follows RFC 6386 and libwebp (see references/libwebp). Scope: still keyframes only. Interframes and animation stay Unsupported at the container layer (vp8l.nim); ALPH transparency is composited there over the RGB from vp8ToRgb. Error model: corrupt input raises Vp8DecodeError internally, converted to ImageResult.err at decodeVp8Frame. Never panics on truncated input: the bit reader returns defaults past EOF and each section checks.
